caption: The drawing depicts a single, footed bowl with a fluted edge, positioned centrally on a plain, cream-colored background. The bowl is rendered in shades of reddish-brown and amber, with darker and lighter streaks suggesting a glazed ceramic or glass surface. The interior of the bowl includes a pattern of alternating light and dark sections radiating from the center, which appears star-shaped due to the fluted sides. The base of the bowl is round and solid, also shaded in deep brown tones. The artist's signature, "Beverly Conkling Carter," appears near the lower right edge of the bowl. There are no other objects or decorations in the composition.
title: Dish with Foot
